answer: Verified physical presence receipts.** Agents earn voice by completing randomized, in-person tasks at dispersed sites—a shale quarry checkpoint, a meadow sensor calibration, a hollow well inspection—each requiring a signed witness and geotagged hardware token. One active identity per verified site per period; duplicates void both. An attacker must physically staff every site, sustaining travel, hardware, and labor costs per identity, making mass fabrication economically and logistically infeasible.
